SQL:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    COUNT(*) AS "orders.n"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  WHERE
    NOT customers.id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name
), _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    SUM(orders.amount - customers.discount) AS "orders.net"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  WHERE
    NOT customers.id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name
), _cm_orders__customers__discount_count AS (
  SELECT
    regions.name AS "customers.regions.name",
    COUNT(customers.discount) AS "customers.discount_count"
  FROM customers AS customers
  LEFT JOIN regions AS regions
    ON customers.region_id = regions.id
  WHERE
    NOT customers.id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    regions.name
)
SELECT
  _base."orders.customers.regions.name",
  _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum."orders.net",
  _base."orders.n",
  COALESCE(_cm_orders__customers__discount_count."customers.discount_count", 0) AS "orders.nd"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum
  ON _base."orders.customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__amount_customers_discount_sum."orders.customers.regions.name"
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__customers__discount_count
  ON _base."orders.customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__customers__discount_count."customers.regions.name"
ORDER BY
  _base."orders.customers.regions.name" ASC
LIMIT 21
